description: Vula skill catalog. NOT currently consulted for routing — core/hrm/orchestrator.py's SKILL_KEYWORDS dict + the keyword-miss LLM fallback are the real source of truth (loaded into HRMOrchestrator._skill_registry but never read after load, as of 2026-07-28). Kept accurate anyway so it isn't misleading documentation; core/skills/loader.py's _SKILLS dict is the authoritative list of what's actually implemented.

skills.name: reasoning
skills.description: General-purpose reasoning and analysis — the default fallback skill

skills.name: web_search

skills.name: memory_recall
skills.description: Query past conversations and learned context

skills.name: file_parse
skills.description: Read, extract and analyse documents and files

skills.name: architecture_planning
skills.description: South African architecture and construction planning — SACAP, JBCC, NHBRC, SANS 10400, BOQ

skills.name: commerce_assistant

skills.name: commerce_admin
skills.description: Merchant/staff admin agent (stock, invoices, broadcasts) and the per-seat sales-rep agent (contacts, meetings, proposals) — reached via a dedicated role-gated path in vula/api/whatsapp.py, not the keyword router

skills.name: clickup_admin

skills.name: calculations

skills.name: google_admin

skills.name: email_admin

skills.name: finance_admin

skills.name: draft_admin
